#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static int k, w;
static unordered_set<long long> s;

void solve(int i, long long sum) {
    if (i > k) {
        s.insert(sum);
        return;
    }
    solve(i + 1, sum + (long long)pow(w, i));
    solve(i + 1, sum);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> w;
    long long n;
    cin >> n;

    k = 0;
    for (int i = 0; w > 2 && i < 21; i++) {
        k = i;
        if (pow(w, i) > 1e9) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (w > 2) solve(0, 0);

    bool bol = false;
    if (w == 2) bol = true;

    for (long long i : s) {
        if (i >= n && s.find(i - n) != s.end()) {
            bol = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (bol) cout << "YES" << "\n";
    else cout << "NO" << "\n";

    return 0;
}
